rows.text: - **SB-UFOGen (few-step adversarial Schrödinger Bridge)**: one-step EARS-Reverb results are reported at PESQ 3.36 / SI-SDR 8.73 dB / ESTOI .88 / MOS Reverb 4.71, close to 50-step SB on that benchmark. Paper timing is measured on an RTX A6000; this is not an established causal streaming implementation, and no usable official checkpoint/inference path was verified. Treat it as a strong utterance-level quality reference, not a selected real-time system.

3. **Best published utterance-level ML reference: SB-UFOGen.** Its one-step EARS-Reverb scores are promising, but no local checkpoint/inference path or streaming behavior was verified. NeMo remains a useful offline baseline.
